question: Techniques of making silk were first invented in China around ______ years ago.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7000.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Techniques for making silk were first invented in China around **7000 years ago.**
 
• The Chinese developed the art of** sericulture**, mastering the cultivation of silkworms and the collection of their silk cocoons.
 
• The secrecy surrounding silk production in China was maintained for centuries, with strict regulations on exporting silkworm eggs or cocoons, allowing the Chinese to maintain a **monopoly on silk.**
 
• The development of **silk production in China **played a pivotal role in the** establishment of the Silk Road,** enabling the exchange of** goods, ideas, and culture between China and other regions.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Similar techniques in other cultures:**

 
 
• **Sericulture in Japan:**

 
 
• **​**The techniques of sericulture and silk production **spread from China to Japan** around the **3rd century CE.**
 
• Japanese sericulture adapted and refined Chinese methods, leading to the establishment of a** unique silk industry in Japan.**
 
 
 
• **Silk production in India:**
 
 
• **​**India has a** rich history of silk production**, with evidence of silk production dating back to ancient times. Indian silk production techniques, known for their intricate designs and vibrant colours, have been developed and passed down through generations.
 
• India is renowned for its various silk types, such as** Banarasi silk, Kanchipuram silk, and Mysore silk.**
 
 
 
 

a2:T
